entry.title: Building a Home SOC Lab
entry.content:
Setting up a home security operations center to practice alert triage and log analysis. Using Wazuh, Elastic Stack, and a DVWA target to simulate real detection scenarios.

What I learned

Running a SIEM in production mode — even a small one — teaches you things tutorials skip. Alert fatigue is real. Tuning rules to reduce noise while keeping signal is the actual job.
